content: Two Papers (ODLRI and Regard-FT) are accepted to ACL 2025! See you in Austria 🇦🇹!
A paper on Diffusion Safety is accepted to ICML 2025 as Spotlight (top 2.6% = 313/12,107)! See you in Canada 🇨🇦!
A paper on Quantization is accepted to ICML 2025 (TTODLer-FM workshop) as Oral!
Official code for ICML 2025 paper is uploaded! Checkout!
I gave a talk at Yonsei MLSys student group on Diffusion models & their privacy issues.
A paper on Diffusion Language Model is accepted to NeurIPS 2025. Kudos to my co-authors! See you in San Diego 🇺🇸!
Two preprints are now available: one on Diffusion Language Model training (Rainbow Padding) and Safety (A2D).
A paper on Machine Unlearning (IDI) is accepted to AAAI 2026!
Two papers on Diffusion LLMs (Rainbow Padding, A2D) accepted to ICLR 2026. See you in Brazil 🇧🇷!
Two papers (DAPD, SRR) accepted to ICML 2026. See you in Seoul 🇰🇷!
Two preprints released: VLM analysis (VLM Tracing) and Safety (DPO-Attack).
Will join KRAFTON AI (AI Companion Team) as a Research Scientist Intern this July 🎉
Happy to share that I received a Silver Medal 🥈 as an ICML 2026 Reviewer.
Two papers (VLM Tracing, DPO-Attack) accepted to NeurIPS 2026. See you in Sydney 🇦🇺!
New preprint (LCR Traps Flexibility) accepted to NeurIPS 2026 workshops (BeNTo, DiffuLM)!
A paper on VLM reward models for robotics (RoboRMBench) accepted to EMNLP 2026 as Oral!
